name: hopya
description: Self-hosted task management with workspaces, hierarchy, five views and optional AI/SSO/S3.

scripts.dev: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @hopya/api" "npm run dev -w @hopya/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:ops
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:ops
scripts.test:browser:container: docker run --rm --init --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --shm-size=1g --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges -e HOME=/tmp -e HOPYA_BROWSER_PORT=44321 -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble@sha256:6446946a1d9fd62d9ae501312a2d76a43ee688542b21622056a372959b65d63d npm run test:browser:all -w @hopya/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
